target: sprul pa bdag gi zhes rlom sems su myi byed/ de rmi lam rlom sems su mi byed/ sprul pa'i mtshan mar yang rlom sems su mi byed pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang / chos thams cad sprul pa lta bu'i bar du yongs su shes par 'gyur ba yin no zhes bya ba ni rnam pa bdun du snang ba'i shes pa'i sbyor ba yin te/
src_sentence: tadā bodhisattvair mahāsattvaiḥ svapnopamāḥ sarvadharmā yāvan nirmitopamāś ca sarvadharmāḥ parijñātā bhavanti. iti saptavidhābhijñānaprayoga  #
